title: Aged Multi
description: It's a rework of the original Aged project, but with Create, more structures, mobs and an economy to get a better experience in multiplayer.
body:
Aged Multi is a medieval and realistic survival modpack based on Aged Light (https://modrinth.com/modpack/aged-light), a modpack from xR4YM0ND where realism and wisdom rule your life, enriched and designed for multiplayer.

_The world is alive : four dynamic seasons follow one another, each with its own challenges. Temperature, hydration and your character's progression matter just as much as your gear._

Aged_ Multi adds three additional pillars :_

⚙️ Create _— Build machines, automate your production and run your artisan industry thanks to Create's rotative mechanics._

💰 Lightman's Currency_— A complete economy integrates into the adventure : player-to-player trading, shops, physical currency. Perfect for bringing a server to life._

🏛️ More structures and mobs _— Unique structures are scattered across the world, offering loot, enemies and stories to discover — and this modpack adds even more so that every exploration is a surprise._

You start with flint tools, you must purify your water, manage your temperature and progress your character by gaining experience. All of this, in cooperation with your friends.
